summary: Frontend-only verification of three features on demo@roujaune.app: (A) Season-card backdrop from Discoveries in ShareCardModal, (B) on-demand 'Send me a test' weekly-recap preview button on /settings, (C) milestone badges on /milestones. Regressions: tg-emailWeekly + digest-day-picker on /settings, and Weekly Digest 'Send test' (digest-email) on /fitness. All items pass. No send buttons were tapped.

settings_email_card.hint_text: We'll email you a clearly-labelled preview so you can see exactly what arrives.

fitness_season_share.note_on_discovery_picker: Absent for demo account — the ShareCardModal.fetchDiscoveries() returned no photos. Request explicitly states this is acceptable ('If there are no discoveries, the strip is simply absent (acceptable)').

context_for_next_testing_agent: Demo account has 0 photo-based Discoveries so season-discovery-picker is intentionally absent (acceptable per spec). All milestones locked (rider stats: 2 rides / 9 km / 1 h — below 10/100/10 thresholds). Do NOT tap send-digest-now, digest-email, or complete any ride — those send real emails / consume free rides.
